financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of common stock with concurrent private placement of warrants; gross proceeds (net not given)
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: On September 15, 2025, the Company closed the Offering, raising gross proceeds of approximately $4.75 million before deducting placement agent fees and other offering expenses payable by the Company.
